original_test_intent: Verify that BMC Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading visibly present all fitted FH11–FH15 TRX readings and thresholds in a human-readable form consistent with the approved specification.
original_method: The owner supplies the exact five-sensor display contract and protected read-only UI access; the reviewer captures both named pages with filters, pagination, refresh and timestamp context and compares rendered fields to approved raw evidence and SPEC.
manual_activity: The BMC UI and FH/link owner approves the five-entry display contract, thresholds and readability criteria, supplies a protected session, reviews both-page captures and decides the verdict. CLI evidence remains a cross-check.
required_inputs: Exact FH11–FH15 TRX names, fitted population and port/module identities
Approved values, units, status and lower/upper threshold fields for each entry
Expected Dashboard card/table and Server Health > Sensor Reading labels and grouping
Human-readable rules for clipping, wrapping, localization, precision, unavailable values and alarm emphasis
Supported browser, viewport/zoom, UI build, refresh interval, filters, sorting and pagination state
Read-only BMC Web credentials/session with TLS validation and screenshot/export retention
Complete timestamp-aligned raw sensor cross-check and same-target BMC/SDR/spec revisions
Independent BMC/link/thermal recovery and secret-redaction rules
safety_requirements: Capture both Dashboard and Server Health pages; one surface cannot stand in for the other
Verify filter, sort, pagination, collapsed groups and refresh state expose all five fitted entries
Use ipmitool only to corroborate identity/value/thresholds, never as UI acceptance evidence
Keep session read-only; do not edit thresholds, acknowledge/clear alerts, reset BMC or clear logs
Redact session tokens and credentials while retaining page/version/timestamp context
Stop on wrong target, stale UI, unreadable/clipped fields, missing thresholds, cross-view mismatch or management/thermal fault
agent_execution_scope: Verify unique source, UI-specific scope and exact five-entry mapping
Open protected read-only Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading on the verified target
Capture full rendered labels, readings, units, status, thresholds, timestamps, filters and pagination
Correlate with complete secret-safe raw sensor evidence and passive link/thermal/SEL context
Perform no CLI-for-UI substitution, threshold/alert action, BMC mutation, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve five-entry UI field/threshold mapping and both-page coverage
Define human-readable display, localization, precision, stale and unavailable criteria
Approve protected session and review complete screenshots/exports plus cross-check

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Mismatched as the primary method: it queries raw IPMI data and truncated SDR but does not open Dashboard or Server Health, prove rendered thresholds or test readability. It may be retained only as a complete, secret-safe cross-check.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a protected read-only BMC Web session to capture both named pages and every FH11–FH15 TRX field with UI state; compare to complete raw evidence and the display SPEC.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both named UI paths and 1/1-minute estimates remain; the prior command-based case is not merged into this checkpoint.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES BMC UI DISPLAY CONTRACT, PROTECTED SESSION AND TWO-SURFACE EVIDENCE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture Dashboard and Server Health at a recorded UI build, viewport and refresh point, enumerate five exact rendered entries, and compare their fields and thresholds with timestamp-aligned raw data.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces DeepSeek's backend-only acceptance with the actual source-required UI interaction while retaining raw IPMI solely for corroboration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A correct raw sensor value does not prove that the UI label, unit, threshold, alarm state or layout is legible and correct on either page.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: UI caching, hidden pagination, responsive clipping or localization can create a presentation defect even when backend data is healthy; screenshots without page state can miss it.

project_override_considerations: If Dashboard summarizes rather than lists all five sensors, the owner must define the expected aggregate/card content and non-overlapping Server Health detail coverage. Browser automation must not bypass the rendered UI with an API-only check.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and unique-code search with row-1895 method separation
Approved five-entry FH/TRX UI field and threshold contract
BMC/UI build, browser, viewport/zoom, locale, refresh, filter/sort/pagination state
Complete Dashboard screenshots/export and Server Health > Sensor Reading screenshots/export
Complete redacted raw cross-check, same-target proof and passive link/thermal/SEL context
No-threshold-edit/no-alert-ack/no-reset/no-write/no-clear audit, statuses, hashes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source clearly requires two BMC Web UI views and human-readable threshold presentation. DeepSeek's backend-only method is inadequate but does not make the source purpose contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The UI validation is identifiable after owner supplies the display contract, protected access and thresholds; these are obtainable prerequisites rather than an irreducible blocker.

review_improvement: Restores the source-required UI method, defines two-surface and layout/readability coverage, and demotes ipmitool from acceptance evidence to a timestamp-aligned cross-check.
independent_technical_reasoning: Backend correctness and UI correctness are independent: cached values, omitted thresholds, responsive clipping, hidden rows or unit localization can fail the user-facing test while ipmitool remains correct. Both named pages must therefore be evaluated as rendered surfaces with their UI state preserved.
